architecture: GRU Encoder + Static Branch + Probabilistic Head
data_sources: Open-Meteo / ECMWF IFS (14-day antecedent weather + soil moisture)
Open-Meteo Flood API / Copernicus GloFAS 4.0 (14-day discharge + climatological mean)
label_method: GloFAS discharge ratio > 1.5 => flood; <= 1.2 => normal; else skipped
label_limitation: Recent-condition modelled-reanalysis proxy (Open-Meteo only exposes the most recent 14 days; DFO historical events 1985-2010 cannot be paired with historical weather). GDACS is never used as a training label.
open_meteo_limitation: Open-Meteo provides only the most recent 14 days of historical data. Multi-year historical reanalysis was not accessible.
deploy_reason: Model AUC=0.895 > climatology AUC=0.500 (improvement=0.395). Deployed for operational risk scoring as calibrated probability input.
